description: Best-effort report of public documentation missing from llmref. Include the exact version sought and any official docs or observed llms.txt URL already found during the task; scoped /docs or versioned llms.txt files are supported. Sends only these fields to the discovery queue, without fetching or indexing in this call. Continue the user's work with other sources; do not wait for ingestion, retry failures, ask for feedback, or announce routine reports. Never send prompts, code, private URLs, credentials or user context. Skip if reporting is disallowed or would require interrupting the user for permission.

docs_url.description: Public official documentation root, if found during the user's task.

llms_txt_url.description: Observed public llms.txt URL, including a /docs or version prefix when present.

project.description: Public library or product name. Do not include prompts or private project details.

version.description: Exact version sought, if known; a request, not proof of the docs' version.

name: report_missing_docs
